title: With Qt 6.10.0, Plasmashell freezes when moving a window with a 1000+ hertz mouse and virtual desktop pager visible
line: Dragging a window around quickly with a high polling rate mouse no longer freezes the panel and desktop while the Pager is shown.
explanation: Each window outline in the Pager binds to model.Geometry, a rect. Since Qt 6.10 such a read gives a value type reference that connects to the property's notify signal and stays connected until the JavaScript garbage collector frees it. During a fast drag the geometry changes at mouse rate, so these connections pile up faster than they are collected, every change has to walk all of them (QQmlNotifier::emitNotify was 66% of the profile), and plasmashell's main thread climbs to 100% CPU and stops answering until well after the drag ends. The change sets pragma ValueTypeBehavior: Copy in the Pager's main.qml, so value types are read as plain copies and nothing gets connected.

commits.message:
applets/pager: copy value types instead of referencing them

Since Qt 6.10, every read of the window geometry made a value type
reference that stays connected to its notify signal until garbage
collection, so dragging a window with a fast mouse froze plasmashell.

BUG: 510046

patches.diff:
From 8e5cdcfeba22fe4c77feed03965b6caabe34e8bf Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:22:42 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/pager: copy value types instead of referencing them

Since Qt 6.10, every read of the window geometry made a value type
reference that stays connected to its notify signal until garbage
collection, so dragging a window with a fast mouse froze plasmashell.

BUG: 510046
---
 applets/pager/qml/main.qml | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/applets/pager/qml/main.qml b/applets/pager/qml/main.qml
index b4211ddbbd..8305e98274 100644
--- a/applets/pager/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/pager/qml/main.qml
@@ -6,6 +6,7 @@
     SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
 */
 pragma ComponentBehavior: Bound
+pragma ValueTypeBehavior: Copy
 
 import QtQuick
 import QtQuick.Layouts
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: plasmashell's main thread CPU during four fast shaking drags of a Konsole window with the Pager visible. It ramps to 100% and stays there; D-Bus calls went unanswered for 12 to 34 s.
With the fix: the same drags (six runs) stay around 15% CPU and plasmashell always answers within 0.2 s.
Master, 8 s into a drag: the Pager (zoomed below) still shows the window at an old position at the bottom of the desktop, because plasmashell is stuck.
With the fix, mid-drag: the Pager outline follows the window in real time.

review.text: Adding pragma ValueTypeBehavior: Copy to applets/pager/qml/main.qml is a strong root-cause fix for the Qt 6.10 value-type reference notify-endpoint pileup triggered by high-polling-rate window drags. All value-type accesses in main.qml (rect, size, point, color, font) are read-only or grouped-property bindings, so switching to Copy semantics introduces no regressions. The profiling data, CPU/latency plots, and mid-drag screenshots convincingly demonstrate the freeze is eliminated.

reviews.text: Adding pragma ValueTypeBehavior: Copy to applets/pager/qml/main.qml is a strong root-cause fix for the Qt 6.10 value-type reference notify-endpoint pileup triggered by high-polling-rate window drags. All value-type accesses in main.qml (rect, size, point, color, font) are read-only or grouped-property bindings, so switching to Copy semantics introduces no regressions. The profiling data, CPU/latency plots, and mid-drag screenshots convincingly demonstrate the freeze is eliminated.

The diagnosis is backed by a perf profile (QQmlNotifier::emitNotify and QQmlDirtyReferenceObject_callback dominating), which fits Qt 6.10's value type references staying connected to the notify signal until GC: the window delegates read geometry.x/y/width/height at mouse rate. pragma ValueTypeBehavior: Copy is the documented, minimal way to opt out, and I found no write-through to value-type sub-properties in pager/main.qml (the drag code writes Item.x/y, not rect members), so the semantics change is safe. The before/after CPU charts and D-Bus latency probes (12-34 s stalls vs at most 0.2 s, plus a no-Pager control) convincingly prove the freeze is gone, and Pager drag-between-desktops still works. Nit: it is worth also filing the reference-object behaviour upstream with Qt, as the notes suggest.
